authority_source: Explicit main-session Owner Adoption — Final Fresh Solo R2 Disposable Allocation / Placement
timestamp_meaning: Local recording time; not independently witnessed or signed
candidate_header_interpretation: Historical candidate header remains unchanged; this separate record establishes adoption of those exact bytes.

allocation.meaning: One per fresh arm; not retries. Allocation approval is not operational creation or execution authorization.

attempt_ceiling_interpretation: Per-ledger counters are not a global mechanical ceiling. Two historical initiated disposable Attempts plus at most two final arm Attempts total four, bounded by owner allocation. No unused historical capacity transfers.
hard_stop: If another harness/infrastructure defect prevents completion, STOP and reassess. No retry, replacement or extra allocation is authorized by that failure.

fixed_placement.remaining_custody_paths: Exactly as adopted candidate; not caller-selected.

preservation_rule: No migration, reset, rewriting or reuse of historical instance-bound state; traces, Attempts, checkpoints, keys, pins and evidence remain preserved.
authority_reuse: Only exact frozen shared material/schema/protocol/contract/input identities under the candidate boundaries. No implicit inheritance of evaluation/Pair/ledger/checkpoint/payload-pin/readiness/cost-extension authority.
authorized_now: one scoped local commit of adopted candidate and necessary authority/memory/PLAN/review records
open_prerequisites: minimal production/launcher binding separately authorized, reviewed and committed
new Pair-specific payload pin adoption only after authorized creation
durability_scope: Local Git durability only after committed verification; no remote durability claim
blob_provenance: No enclosing self-referential commit embedded; baseline is parent.
stop: After committed bytes/SHA256/blob verification. No implementation or operational continuation.
